battle.name: 查科戰爭
battle.theater: 格蘭查科荒漠與沼澤地帶
battle.brief: 查科戰爭（1932‑1935）是玻利維亞與巴拉圭在格蘭查科荒漠與沼澤地帶的武裝衝突，雙方軍隊均裝備英國授權製造的維克斯.303水冷式機槍，該槍於1912年服役，並在激烈前線中發揮關鍵火力支援。

kit.name: 維克斯.303水冷式機槍
kit.history: 作為英國軍的標準中型機槍，維克斯.303在一次大戰與後續衝突中被廣泛使用，以其水冷式結構提供持續火力支援，成為步兵與火力支援的主力裝備。

countries: 交戰國為巴拉圭與玻利維亞，戰場集中在兩國之間的查科地區。巴拉圭的軍事目標是沿查科南部建立較靠近巴拉圭河的安全邊界，並鞏固從阿松森通往北方哨站的路線；玻利維亞則力圖在北部取得足以控制上游航道與邊防的區域。這不是一條天然清楚的界線，兩國引用不同的殖民時期文件，對河道源頭、島嶼及內陸分水嶺各有解讀。地形由南向北逐步低平，遍布喬木林、灌木、河曲、積水與季節性泥濘，築路和運補往往比正面射擊更能決定戰局。
countriesEn: The belligerents were Paraguay and Bolivia, and the fighting was concentrated in the Chaco between them. Paraguay’s military objective was to establish a security boundary closer to the Paraguay River along the southern Chaco and secure the route from Asunción to northern outposts; Bolivia sought to obtain an area in the north sufficient to control the upper navigation route and frontier defense. The boundary was not a naturally clear line. The two states cited different colonial-era documents and interpreted river sources, islands, and inland watersheds differently. The land slopes gradually toward lower ground from south to north and is covered with woodland, scrub, river bends, standing water, and seasonal mud. Road construction and sustainment therefore often mattered more to the course of the battle than frontal fire.
people: 一九三二年開戰時，玻利維亞由恩里克．佩納蘭達總統兼陸軍最高指揮官主持戰局，他持續徵召與整編，並把鐵路運輸和糧秣列為優先工作。北部的主要作戰先後由何塞．費利克斯．布蘭科將軍統率；他後來又在阿巴波主持反攻。一九三二年十一月攻擊普韋爾托布斯科堡時，陸軍中校塞韋羅．費爾南德斯率領突擊縱隊，陣亡後該堡以他命名。巴拉圭由參謀長何塞．費利克斯．埃斯蒂加里瓦將軍籌劃全線攻勢，之後又直接統率北部增援與突破。何塞．阿古斯丁．恩西索中將指揮第二師，其部隊在克拉拉薩受困被俘，而後續部隊在馬里薩爾埃斯蒂加里瓦完成戰術突圍。
peopleEn: When war began in 1932, President and Army supreme commander Enrique Peñaranda directed Bolivia’s war effort, continuing mobilization and consolidation while giving priority to rail transport and supplies. Major operations in the north were at various stages commanded by General José Félix Blanco, who later led the counterattack at Abapó. During the assault on Puerto Busch in November 1932, Lieutenant Colonel Severo Fernández led the strike force; after his death, the fort was renamed in his honor. Paraguay’s offensive across the entire front was planned by Chief of Staff General José Félix Estigarriba, who later personally commanded reinforcements and relief operations in the north. Major General José Agustín Enciso commanded the Second Division, whose troops were surrounded and captured at Clarazá, while a following force achieved a tactical breakout at Mariscal Estigarriba.
kits: 前線火力以栓動步槍、七五毫米野戰炮及一〇五毫米榴彈炮為核心。玻利維亞步兵可見Krueger M1904式舊步槍，並配用施耐德75毫米山地炮M1907/36；巴拉圭大量使用7.65×53.5毫米Mauser M1895步槍，雙方再以重機槍、輕機槍和迫擊炮補射界與林間目標。少量Schneider CA1與Vickers 6噸戰車多依賴公路，自重、履帶、涉水與散熱在雨季限制行動；巴拉圭亦使用Vickers 6噸系列。航空方面，玻利維亞投入Curtiss F11C-2 Hawk II、Curtiss P-36A Hawk與Douglas O-38系列，巴拉圭使用Martin 2T-1B Master及Dornier Merklin，這些型號均在一九三二年以前已經列裝。
kitsEn: Front-line firepower centered on bolt-action rifles, 75 mm field guns, and 105 mm howitzers. Bolivian infantry included the older Krueger Model 1904 rifle and used the Schneider 75 mm mountain gun Model 1907/36; Paraguay extensively used 7.65 × 53.5 mm Mauser Model 1895 rifles, while both sides supplemented them with heavy and light machine guns and mortars. Small numbers of Schneider CA1 and Vickers 6-Ton tanks depended heavily on roads, with weight, tracks, water crossings, and cooling limiting movement during the rainy season; Paraguay also operated vehicles from the Vickers 6-Ton series. In aviation, Bolivia employed the Curtiss F11C-2 Hawk II, Curtiss P-36A Hawk, and Douglas O-38 series, while Paraguay used the Martin 2T-1B Master and Dornier Merklin. All of these types had entered service before 1932.
tactics: 一九三二年五月二十九日，巴拉圭在拂曉以炮火準備打開約一百七十公里的接觸正面，步兵不排成連續攻擊線，而以分散縱隊沿林間小徑與河岸通道推進，使玻利維亞無法及時連繫的孤立哨所逐個陷落。七月至九月，玻利維亞把一個師的集中兵力投入科拉萊斯方向，反覆攻擊道路交會處與林木間高地，但巴拉圭守軍及反擊迫使它退回。十一月一日至三日，玻利維亞突擊縱隊攻向普韋爾托布斯科堡，十一月二十九日前後的外圍攻勢受挫後，堡內守軍於三日被逐出，雖然取得巴拉圭河畔的立足點，卻沒有立即建立可持續向南方輸送的補給線。一九三三年一月十七日至十八日，玻利維亞依次奪取納納瓦與納納瓦拉古納，巴拉圭四月四日的反擊未能收復該地。三月克拉拉薩一帶，恩西索所率第二師被包圍後投降；八月底至九月初，埃斯蒂加里瓦率增援縱隊在馬里薩爾埃斯蒂加里瓦突破包圍。一九三四年，巴拉圭先在亞卡雷取得突破，隨後通過伊維庫伊，進抵卡阿庫佩、卡拉佩瓜及布魯埃斯將軍鎮一線，但三月二十七日阿巴波戰鬥阻止深入。從此雙方沿主要道路和河道構築縱深陣地，進行炮兵射擊、空中巡邏與小規模突擊，直至停火。
tacticsEn: At dawn on 29 May 1932, Paraguay opened the fighting with an artillery preparation across an active front roughly 170 kilometers wide. Instead of forming a continuous assault line, its infantry advanced in dispersed columns along woodland tracks and riverbank paths, isolating Bolivian outposts that could not be reduced directly. From July through September, Bolivia concentrated a division toward Corrales and repeatedly attacked track junctions and wooded high ground, but Paraguayan defenses and counterattacks forced it back. Between 1 and 3 November, a Bolivian strike force moved against Puerto Busch; after an unsuccessful attempt around the perimeter, the defenders were driven out on the third. The capture provided a foothold on the Paraguay River but did not immediately create a sustainable supply route into the south. On 17 and 18 January 1933, Bolivia took Nanawa and Nanawa Laguna in succession, while a Paraguayan counterattack on 4 April failed to recover them. At Clarazá in March, Enciso’s Second Division was surrounded and captured; between late August and early September, Estigarriba led a reinforcing column to break out at Mariscal Estigarriba. In 1934, Paraguay first broke through at Yacare and then advanced through Ybycuí toward Caacupé, Carapeguá, and General Bruguéz, but the Battle of Abapó on 27 March prevented further penetration. Thereafter, both sides constructed depth positions along the principal roads and waterways and conducted artillery fire, aerial patrols, and limited local attacks until the ceasefire.
data: 兵力資料必須區分前線實數與全國可動員總數。常見軍史估計把一九三二年五月可調兵員列為巴拉圭約三萬人、玻利維亞約一萬四千人；至停火前，玻利維亞總動員通常估為二十萬至二十五萬人，巴拉圭約十五萬人。這些數字包括後方、預備與輪替部隊，不能直接當作同一日期的作戰兵力。巴拉圭的運補主軸是亞松森至卡阿庫佩的鐵路，再由600毫米Decauville輕便鐵路向布魯埃斯將軍鎮及北方哨堡延伸；玻利維亞則由拉巴斯經奧魯羅、烏尤尼與阿托查，再以公路接維拉蒙特斯及Cuatro Ciudades，另一條補給線由聖克魯斯鐵路通往亞庫阿雷與波爾通。七五毫米高爆榴彈、機槍彈鏈和手榴彈先由火車、貨車送至後方終點，再用馬匹和人力分送砲位；燃料、輪胎、備件、糧食與醫療用品同樣受到運輸距離限制。雨季道路泥濘、瘧疾與腸道疾病又妨礙輪替和長期駐紮，因此本文不把來源互不一致的精確傷亡數字視為定論。
dataEn: Military figures must distinguish troops actually at the front from the national pools available for mobilization. Common military-history estimates place Paraguay’s forces available in May 1932 at about 30,000 men and Bolivia’s at about 14,000; by the ceasefire, total mobilization is generally estimated at roughly 200,000 to 250,000 for Bolivia and about 150,000 for Paraguay. These totals included rear-area, reserve, and replacement troops and cannot be treated as simultaneous combat strength. Paraguay’s main supply axis ran by rail from Asunción to Caacupé, followed by a 600 mm Decauville light railway toward General Bruguéz and the northern outposts. Bolivia used a route through La Paz, Oruro, Uyuni, and Atocha, followed by road transport to Villamontes and Cuatro Ciudades; another supply line ran from the Santa Cruz railway toward Yacuare and Portón. Seventy-five-millimeter high-explosive shells, machine-gun belts, and grenades were carried first by train and truck to rear depots and then distributed to gun positions by pack animals and manpower; fuel, tires, spare parts, food, and medical supplies were constrained by the same distances. Muddy rainy-season roads, malaria, and intestinal disease further disrupted rotation and prolonged occupation, so disputed single totals for battle casualties are not treated here as established fact.
cause: 衝突的直接源頭，是兩國對邊界測量與解釋長期不一致。十九世紀留下的地圖、河川資料，以及一八七〇年《洛伊薩加－科特希佩條約》和一八七四年《阿亞喬喬條約》所形成的邊界安排，從未產生雙方都接受的查科界線。玻利維亞把北查科視為阻止內陸軍力與道路向巴拉圭河伸展的屏障，巴拉圭則擔心玻利維亞哨堡及後方道路逐步逼近主要河運帶。兩國在一九三一年前後曾談判並嘗試組織邊界委員會，但未形成共同方案；巴伊亞內格拉與中部前哨的巡邏、封鎖和零星交火隨之增加。當地方事件不再局限於小隊接觸，雙方把控制水井、渡口和道路節點視為鞏固邊界的實際手段，地方衝突遂擴大成全面戰爭。
causeEn: The immediate source of the conflict was a long-standing disagreement over boundary surveying and legal interpretation. Colonial maps, river records, and the frontier arrangements associated with the 1870 Treaty of Loizaga-Cotegipe and the 1874 Treaty of Ayacucho never produced a Chaco boundary accepted by both states. Bolivia regarded the northern Chaco as a buffer preventing inland military roads and forces from extending toward the Paraguay River, while Paraguay feared that Bolivian outposts and rear-area roads would progressively approach its principal river corridor. Around 1931 the two governments negotiated and attempted to organize a boundary commission, but no common settlement followed; patrols, blockades, and isolated exchanges of fire increased around Bahía Negra and the central outposts. Once local incidents were no longer limited to small-unit contact, each side treated control of wells, crossings, and road junctions as the practical means of securing its frontier, expanding the confrontation into general war.
impact: 從一九三四年延續到一九三五年的僵局顯示，能突破前線不等於能持續佔領土地。巴拉圭雖曾深入玻利維亞控制區超過一百公里，但道路、鐵路與空運沒有同步前伸，縱隊分散後，貨車、馬匹飼料、燃料和備件難以跟上。空軍可以偵察和襲擊，卻受跑道、炸藥、燃油與維修能力限制；少量戰車常因泥濘、履帶故障和涉水問題停在道路附近。巴拉圭占據較多南部陣地，玻利維亞則保住北部，並以更長的鐵路與公路後方線進行反擊。長期駐防受到疾病、飲水、草料及輪替效率限制，任何一方都難以再集中力量發動具有決定效果的新攻勢。戰後兩國都擴大後備與工程編制，把道路、橋梁、無線電、航空和裝備維修納入軍隊計畫；巴拉圭獲得較有利的軍事位置，玻利維亞則重新調整裝甲、機械化與空軍快速取勝的方案。
impactEn: The stalemate from 1934 into 1935 showed that breaking the front did not automatically permit an army to occupy and supply captured ground. Paraguay advanced more than 100 kilometers into Bolivian-held territory, but roads, railways, and air transport did not extend at the same rate. Once its columns dispersed, trucks, pack-animal fodder, fuel, and spare parts could not keep pace. Aircraft could reconnoiter and attack, yet airfields, explosives, fuel, and maintenance imposed limits; the small tank force repeatedly stopped near roads because of mud, track failures, and water crossings. Paraguay occupied a larger share of the southern positions, while Bolivia retained the north and used its longer railway and road network for counterattacks. Prolonged occupation was constrained by disease, water, fodder, and the efficiency of troop rotation, making it difficult for either state to concentrate for another decisive offensive. Afterward, both countries expanded reserve and engineer formations and incorporated roads, bridges, wireless communication, aviation, and equipment maintenance into military planning. Paraguay emerged in a more favorable military position, while Bolivia revised plans that relied on armor and air power for rapid victory.
result: 軍事上的直接終點是一九三五年六月十二日停火。停火通知下達後，雙方在前線舉行地方會商，開始交換俘虜並撤收部分突出陣地，其餘前線位置成為後來劃界的主要基礎，正式法律安排則延至一九三八年。二月三日，玻利維亞與巴拉圭在布宜諾斯艾利斯簽訂和平條約，約將查科地區四分之三劃給巴拉圭，玻利維亞保留北部約四分之一，並取得巴拉圭河的航行權。條約簽訂後，兩國再由軍事代表與測量人員標定陸地邊界。因此，一九三五年停火結束了實際戰鬥，一九三八年的條約則把停火時形成的控制線轉化為新的國際邊界。
resultEn: The immediate military conclusion was the ceasefire of 12 June 1935. After notifications were exchanged, the two sides held local meetings, began returning prisoners of war, and withdrew from some salient positions; the remaining forward lines became the principal basis for later demarcation, while the formal legal settlement came later. On 3 February 1938, Bolivia and Paraguay signed a peace treaty in Buenos Aires that assigned roughly three-quarters of the Chaco to Paraguay, left Bolivia about one-quarter in the north, and confirmed Bolivia’s navigation rights on the Paraguay River. Military and survey representatives subsequently established the land boundary. The 1935 ceasefire therefore ended active combat, while the 1938 treaty converted the positions arising from the truce into a new international frontier.
